The Confluence Of Risks

Louis-Vincent Gave

Gavekal Research | 19 Oct 2026

In a recently published piece, we reviewed a long list of tail risks liable to shake global financial markets (see Heads, Or Tails?). Last week, three seemed to materialize in earnest. Specifically:However, with the midterms now around the corner, the ability of the Trump administration to keep energy prices down is rapidly disappearing; thereby leaving the market with the great uncertainty of what will happen to near-term energy prices when inventories everywhere are low, or even non-existent, wars in Russia/Ukraine and across the Middle East continue to rage, ships are scarce, refineries and pipelines are being destroyed, and key sea lanes (whether Black Sea, Red Sea or Persian Gulf) are not entirely safe.
